title: Kissed Creamy Argentinian Beef Skillet
description: A jammy and creamy Argentinian dish featuring sherry vinegar and flambe, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly. This recipe combines the richness of beef with the tanginess of sherry vinegar.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sherry vinegar and flambe the mixture, stirring constantly, until the liquid is almost completely evaporated.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and add the heavy cream, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Simmer the mixture for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and the beef is cooked through.
